0022600228.text: The Wizards (4-7, 10th in the East) host the Pistons (7-3, 1st in the Central) in Washington's 13th game of the season, with Washington on a four-game losing streak and 2-5 on the road. The teams have met once this season, with Detroit winning 122-111 in Detroit, which leaves the Wizards trailing 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 1-3 in 2025-26. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), and Ugonna Onyenso (foot) is day-to-day and a game-time decision.
